verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer's own docs say it analyzes data from connected sources (Snowflake, Databricks, Google Sheets, Salesforce) and processes user files (CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF), with code running in a sandboxed VM. That is the product itself generating AI analysis of the user's data. The Analytics API covers usage metrics, not insights, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of insight or suggestion outputs (not just 'analyze'), any in-depth description of the analysis workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Analyze data from Snowflake, Databricks, Google Sheets, Salesforce, and other sources
Process CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF, images, audio, and video files.
Computer runs code in a sandboxed Linux VM with a persistent file workspace.
